has musical time frame

  • CURIE: gmeow:hasMusicalTimeFrame
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasMusicalTimeFrame
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/music

Relates a MusicalTimeSpan to the MusicalTimeFrame in which its start and duration are expressed. Non-functional globally so that coexisting frames may be asserted; each MusicalTimeSpan is constrained to exactly one frame by SHACL (Principle 11).

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan -> gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame Sub-property of: gmeow:hasReferenceFrame

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:hasMusicalTimeFrame from gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan to gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasReferenceFrame, gmeow:MusicalTimeSpan, gmeow:MusicalTimeFrame
